@concat('"WITH MEMCTE
     AS (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME,
                         SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,
                         SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                         SBSB.SBSB_CK,
                         MEME.MEME_CK,
                         MEME.MEME_HICN,
                         MEPE.CSCS_ID,
                         MEPE.CSPI_ID,
                         MEMD.BGBG_CK,
                         CONTRACT.BGBG_ID,
                         MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD,
                         MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT,
                         MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT,
                         MEMD.MEMD_MCTR_PBP,
                         MEMD.MEMD_SEGMENT_ID,
                         SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT,
                         SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT
           FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP  GRGR
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                    ON     SBSB.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK
                       AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%MCR%'' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%PDP%'')
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
                    ON     MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
                       AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
                       AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                              FROM DUAL) BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT
                                             AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
                JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD
                    ON     MEMD.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
                       AND MEMD.MEMD_EVENT_CD IN (''PBP'', ''SCCC'')
                       AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                              FROM DUAL) BETWEEN MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT
                                             AND MEMD.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT
                LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP CONTRACT
                    ON CONTRACT.BGBG_CK = MEMD.BGBG_CK
                LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR
                    ON     SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSR.SBSB_CK
                       AND SBSR.PDBL_ID = ''LEP''
                       AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                              FROM DUAL) BETWEEN SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT
                                             AND SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT),
     BILLCTE
     AS (  SELECT CTE.SBSB_CK,
                  BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
                  ''N''              AS SPLIT_TO_IND,
                  INSB.PDBL_ID,
                  SUM (BLSB_PREM_SB) AS BLSB_PREM_SB
             FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK, SBSB_ID
                     FROM MEMCTE) CTE
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I''
                  JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT  in  (''DRBL'',''EFT'',''None'')
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
                         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT =
                                 TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                  JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB
                      ON     BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = INSB.BLIV_ID
                         AND INSB.PDBL_ID IN (''MED'',
                                              ''DENT'',
                                              ''DRUG'',
                                              ''VISN'',
                                              ''LEP'',
                                              ''LIS'',
                                              ''SPAP'')
  AND INSB.BLSB_DISP_CD=''M''        GROUP BY CTE.SBSB_CK, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, INSB.PDBL_ID
         UNION
           SELECT CTE.SBSB_CK,
                  BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
                  ''B''              AS SPLIT_TO_IND,
                  INSB.PDBL_ID,
                  SUM (BLSB_PREM_SB) AS BLSB_PREM_SB
             FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK, SBSB_ID
                     FROM MEMCTE) CTE
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP
                      ON     SBSP.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT
                                               AND SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
                      ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT
                         AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = ''B''
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
                         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''B''
                  JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
                         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT =
                                 TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('gv_StartDate')), '"'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                  JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB
                      ON     BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = INSB.BLIV_ID
                         AND INSB.PDBL_ID IN (''MED'',
                                              ''DENT'',
                                              ''DRUG'',
                                              ''VISN'',
                                              ''LEP'',
                                              ''LIS'',
                                              ''SPAP'')
                         AND INSB.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
    AND INSB.BLSB_DISP_CD=''M''      GROUP BY CTE.SBSB_CK, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, INSB.PDBL_ID)
SELECT CTE1.SBSB_LAST_NAME,
       CTE1.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,
       CTE1.MEME_HICN,
       CTE2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
       CTE1.BGBG_CK,
       CTE1.BGBG_ID,
       CTE1.MEMD_EVENT_CD,
       CTE1.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT,
       CTE1.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT,
       CTE1.MEMD_MCTR_PBP,
       CTE1.MEMD_SEGMENT_ID,
       CTE2.PDBL_ID,
       CTE2.BLSB_PREM_SB AS INSB_PREM_SB,
       CTE1.CSCS_ID,
       CTE1.CSPI_ID,
       CTE2.BLSB_PREM_SB,
       CTE1.SBSR_EFF_DT,
       CTE1.SBSR_TERM_DT,
       CTE1.SBSB_CK,
       CTE1.MEME_CK,
       CTE2.SPLIT_TO_IND SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND,
       CTE1.SBSB_ID
  FROM MEMCTE CTE1 JOIN BILLCTE CTE2 ON CTE1.SBSB_CK = CTE2.SBSB_CK"')

SubscriberInvoice.value: 'SELECT         s.SBSB_LAST_NAME,         s.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,         s.SBSB_ID,         s.SBSB_CK,         b.BLBL_DUE_DT,         b.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST,         m.MEME_CK,         d.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND,         m.MEME_HICN     FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC s     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m         ON m.SBSB_CK = s.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM p         ON p.SBSB_CK = s.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL d         ON p.SBSB_CK = d.SBSB_CK             AND p.SBSP_EFF_DT = d.SBSP_EFF_DT     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO i         ON i.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = d.BGBG_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM b         ON b.BLEI_CK = i.BLEI_CK     WHERE m.MEME_SFX = 0          AND d.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = 'B'         AND TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN p.SBSP_EFF_DT AND p.SBSP_TERM_DT         AND i.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'         AND b.BLBL_DUE_DT = TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')     UNION      SELECT         s.SBSB_LAST_NAME,         s.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,         s.SBSB_ID,         s.SBSB_CK,         b.BLBL_DUE_DT,         b.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST,         m.MEME_CK,         d.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND,         m.MEME_HICN     FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC s     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER m         ON m.SBSB_CK = s.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM p         ON p.SBSB_CK = s.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL d         ON p.SBSB_CK = d.SBSB_CK             AND p.SBSP_EFF_DT = d.SBSP_EFF_DT     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO i         ON i.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = s.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM b         ON b.BLEI_CK = i.BLEI_CK     WHERE m.MEME_SFX = 0          AND d.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = 'N'         AND TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN p.SBSP_EFF_DT AND p.SBSP_TERM_DT         AND i.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'         AND b.BLBL_DUE_DT = TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')'

                    ON     SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSR.SBSB_CK
                       AND SBSR.PDBL_ID = 'LEP'
                       AND (SELECT TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                              FROM DUAL) BETWEEN SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT
                                             AND SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT),
     BILLCTE
     AS (  SELECT CTE.SBSB_CK,
                  BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
                  'N'              AS SPLIT_TO_IND,
                  INSB.PDBL_ID,
                  SUM (BLSB_PREM_SB) AS BLSB_PREM_SB
             FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK, SBSB_ID
                     FROM MEMCTE) CTE
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
                  JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT  in  ('DRBL','EFT','None')
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
                         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT =
                                 TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                  JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB
                      ON     BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = INSB.BLIV_ID
                         AND INSB.PDBL_ID IN ('MED',
                                              'DENT',
                                              'DRUG',
                                              'VISN',
                                              'LEP',
                                              'LIS',
                                              'SPAP')
  AND INSB.BLSB_DISP_CD='M'        GROUP BY CTE.SBSB_CK, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, INSB.PDBL_ID
         UNION
           SELECT CTE.SBSB_CK,
                  BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
                  'B'              AS SPLIT_TO_IND,
                  INSB.PDBL_ID,
                  SUM (BLSB_PREM_SB) AS BLSB_PREM_SB
             FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_CK, SBSB_ID
                     FROM MEMCTE) CTE
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP
                      ON     SBSP.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT
                                               AND SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
                      ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
                         AND SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT
                         AND SBSD.SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND = 'B'
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSD.BGBG_CK
                         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B'
                  JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLDF.BLEI_CK
                         AND (SELECT TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                                FROM DUAL) BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT
                                               AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
                  JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
                      ON     BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
                         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT =
                                 TO_DATE ('7/1/2018', 'mm/dd/yyyy')
                  JOIN FACETS.CDS_INSB_SB_DETAIL INSB
                      ON     BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = INSB.BLIV_ID
                         AND INSB.PDBL_ID IN ('MED',
                                              'DENT',
                                              'DRUG',
                                              'VISN',
                                              'LEP',
                                              'LIS',
                                              'SPAP')
                         AND INSB.SBSB_CK = CTE.SBSB_CK
    AND INSB.BLSB_DISP_CD='M'      GROUP BY CTE.SBSB_CK, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, INSB.PDBL_ID)
SELECT CTE1.SBSB_LAST_NAME,
       CTE1.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,
       CTE1.MEME_HICN,
       CTE2.BLDF_MCTR_STMT,
       CTE1.BGBG_CK,
       CTE1.BGBG_ID,
       CTE1.MEMD_EVENT_CD,
       CTE1.MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT,
       CTE1.MEMD_HCFA_TERM_DT,
       CTE1.MEMD_MCTR_PBP,
       CTE1.MEMD_SEGMENT_ID,
       CTE2.PDBL_ID,
       CTE2.BLSB_PREM_SB AS INSB_PREM_SB,
       CTE1.CSCS_ID,
       CTE1.CSPI_ID,
       CTE2.BLSB_PREM_SB,
       CTE1.SBSR_EFF_DT,
       CTE1.SBSR_TERM_DT,
       CTE1.SBSB_CK,
       CTE1.MEME_CK,
       CTE2.SPLIT_TO_IND SBSD_SPLT_TO_IND,
       CTE1.SBSB_ID
  FROM MEMCTE CTE1 JOIN BILLCTE CTE2 ON CTE1.SBSB_CK = CTE2.SBSB_CK'
